project.name: League Of Data Base
project.summary: Free multilingual League data reference built from Data Dragon, with any-patch switching, shareable item builds, trends and an API.

about.text: Free multilingual League data reference built from Data Dragon, with any-patch switching, shareable item builds, trends and an API.

languages.text: 21 languages matching Riot's published locales (English, French, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, both Chinese forms named)

updates.text: New patches picked up from Riot's version list as soon as they appear, 'usually within hours' of a game patch going live; previous patches stay browsable.

data_sources.text: Riot Games Data Dragon, with Community Dragon for skin chromas; 'Nothing is hand-edited.'

license.text: Licence file present but not matched to a standard SPDX id (GitHub reports NOASSERTION)

history.text: Public REST API with key-based access and developers page launched (1.9.0 'Passerelle')
Voluntary donations via Stripe and a Supporter badge introduced (1.8.0 'Offrande')
Earliest public web-archive capture we found
